title: Studied
summary: STUDIED, participle passive [from study.] 1. Read; closely examined; read with diligence and attention; well considered. The book has been studied The subject has been well studied 2. adjective Learne

inlines.v: STUDIED, participle passive [from study.] 1. Read; closely examined; read with diligence and attention; well considered. The book has been studied The subject has been well studied 2. adjective Learned; well versed in any branch of learning; qualified by study; as a man well studied in geometry, or in law or medical science. 3. Having a particular inclination. [Not in use.]
